_: Decision states for gating queue eligibility. This file is NOT a governance
register and does not record decisions: MASTER_PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md,
decision-log.md and docs/adr/ are authoritative. This mirrors their state so
scripts/skills-agent-coordinator.mjs can REFUSE to schedule work whose owner
decision is unresolved, instead of relying on a human to remember.
A blocker entry carrying `decision: "<id>"` is cleared ONLY when that id's
state here is `implementation_authorized`. Every other state, and an id that
is absent, keeps the veto -- fail-closed, because a typo must not authorize.
States, in order. Each is a separate act; none implies the next:
proposed                an answer has been put to the owner, nothing more
conflict_checked        checked against protected decisions; result recorded
accepted                the owner accepted it, verbatim, with provenance
recorded                written into the authoritative register(s)
implementation_authorized   the ONLY state that unblocks a gated task
implementation_verified     the change landed and passed its gates
promoted                the finding reached its formal closure class
`record` names where the authoritative text lives, or null while it has no
home. `owner` and `answeredAt` stay null until the owner actually supplies
them -- never inferred, never defaulted to today's date.

GOV-AUTH-1.question: Who is the decision authority, when does a direction become effective, and how are source conflicts resolved?
GOV-AUTH-1.proposedAnswer: Julia as product owner is the decision authority; a protected governance decision is effective only once recorded through MASTER_PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md section 2 with owner attribution, scope, status and auditable evidence; process amendments need explicit approval and must be labelled as such; on conflict preserve state and request owner resolution
GOV-AUTH-1.source: owner direction in conversation, 2026-10-21; recorded verbatim at docs/V5_OWNER_AUTHORITY_DIRECTION_2026-10-21.md section 1
GOV-AUTH-1.note: CONTENT SUPPLIED BY THE OWNER, RECORDING ACT NOT PERFORMED. owner and answeredAt stay null because the direction's own sentence 2 makes effectiveness depend on being recorded through the approved procedure, and all four files that procedure touches are protected roots that refuse tool writes. This entry keeps the gate CLOSED until that recording exists. Do not set this to implementation_authorized on the strength of the conversation alone.
GOV-AUTH-1.blocksNote: These are gated on the authority rule being EFFECTIVE, not merely stated. Each also needs its own substantive approval.
